The user wants me to create a speech-to-text program for Linux with the following features:
1. Activates when you press a keyboard shortcut that can be changed
2. Shows a little GUI
3. Works offline or with an API for whisper
4. Lets you download different offline speech-to-text models

This is a complex task that involves multiple components:
- GUI framework (likely GTK or Qt for Linux)
- Keyboard shortcut handling
- Speech recognition (offline models and Whisper API)
- Model downloading functionality
- Configuration management

I should break this down into manageable tasks and create a todo list. This is definitely a complex multi-step task that requires careful planning.

Let me start by creating a todo list to track all the components needed for this speech-to-text program.
